newsitem.title: UK: Sheffield Forgemasters ponders demerger and float.
newsitem.headline: Sheffield Forgemasters ponders demerger and float.

text.p: Unlisted Sheffield Forgemasters Group said on Wednesday it is considering demerging its aerospace and engineering divisions and may float them separately on the London Stock Exchange.
It said the demerged aerospace division could be listed on the stock market next year, under the new name of Engineering Technologies Group Plc.
The engineering division, the new name of which has yet to be decided, would also seek a listing at a later date.
"The two businesses have very different dynamics and require different resources," said Philip Wright, group chief executive.
The group makes steel forgings and castings for applications including the manufacture of engine parts, surgical implants and joints for oil rig platforms.
The company's turnover for the fiscal year 1996 was 144 million stg.
